title: ExxonMobil Announces 2025 Results
author: Sigma Capital
metaDescription: SPRING, Texas – January 30, 2026 – Exxon Mobil Corporation today announced fourth-quarter 2025 earnings of $6.5 billion, or $1.53 per share.
